recentItems.title: 2026 Lorain County Fair (Wellington, OH)
recentItems.description:
Hard to believe it’s already the end of August, so that means it’s time for two of Ohio’s biggest fairs. This week it’s the insanely popular Lorain County Fair in Wellington, OH. McGinnis Amusements once again brought their entire ride lineup featuring their Chance Wipeout, Wisdom Aladin, Chance YoYo (which was actually tilting, albeit for a brief time), and Dartron Hurricane. Rounding out the catalog were Kissel Amusements Ali Babba and the always popular Round Up Your Skittles. No POV’s this time as I didn’t feel like waiting in the rather long line to buy tickets/wristbands. The first minute is mostly me walking past the food vendors, so feel free to skip ahead to the rides if you want to see the fun stuff.

Next week should be my annual Canfield Fair visit and then in September, I should be visiting Delaware, Wayne and Tuscarawas County Fairs. Again, a sincere thank you to all who watched my videos this month as it was indeed my biggest month ever. And to think I wasn’t going to do this in 2026. 🤦🏻‍♂️.

My apologies about cutting up the Wipeout footage. I uploaded this 4 times and got dinged for Pitbull’s crappy music playing. Maybe Sensory Friendly days are the best days to go to avoid dealing with this!

recentItems.title: 2026 Erie County Fair (Hamburg, NY)
recentItems.description:
Bonus fair this week- the huge Erie County Fair in Hamburg, NY near Buffalo. Strates Shows provided the midway as usual and this year the midway was the same as last year, minus the Rock Star (which was booked in through Monkey Maze Inc). This is the first time I have visited the fair and there has not been a new ride. Rides included in this video include their Reverchon Himalaya, Pinfari Zyklon (with POV. The coaster is smaller than the one they had last year), Huss Pirate, Bertazzon Musik Express, and the newly-reskinned Haunted Mansion (with POV). They were being real sticklers with the “no single riders” rule this year, so no Ferris wheel or StarFlyer footage. 🤬

I should point out that I did not manage to get all the rides on here. I missed The Force (Gravitron), Scooter, Skyfall (down), and most kids rides and/or slides. You can see some of them in the background of the clips featured here. 

As always, thanks for watching and I appreciate your support. This has been one of my best months ever in terms of views, so sincerely, thank you.

recentItems.title: 2026 Cuyahoga County Fair (Berea, OH)
recentItems.description:
Another week, another fair. This year’s Cuyahoga County Fair once again had PrimeTime Carnival Company supplying the rides with the lineup featuring the usual suspects (Alpine Bobs, King Swing, YoYo, No Limit, Tilt-A-Whirl), plus their newest addition, Mantis, a Guven Rides Kamikaze. 

Due to a thunderstorm about an hour prior to my filming this, the fair was pretty dead, so getting ride footage was a bit of a challenge… so I just made a loop around the grounds so you can see everything that was in attendance. There’s also some on-ride footage of the Hurricane roller coaster, Drop Zone drop tower, King Swing, and a ride through PrimeTime’s absolutely awful dark ride, Devil’s Den. This thing is a joke as it’s mostly just darkness with a few static props inside. 

Next week will be an off week, then the following 2 weeks will feature the Lorain County Fair and the Canfield Fair. As always, enjoy and thanks for watching (really appreciate the love these past few videos).

recentItems.title: 2026 Medina County Fair (Medina, OH)
recentItems.description:
Fair season is ramping up quickly here in northeast Ohio with this year’s Medina County Fair going on through August 9th. Bates Brothers Amusements again provided the midway, bringing along all the same rides they always do- ARM Vertigo, Quasar and RockStar, Eli Eagle 16 Wheel, Majestic Scooters, and the Dartron Cliff Hanger and Zero Gravity (which was down “for maintenance”). Bates hasn’t gotten anything new now for several years, so the ride lineup does seem a bit stale. 

Next up will be the Cuyahoga County Fair featuring PrimeTime Amusements, and then later this month will be the Lorain County Fair and the always fun Canfield Fair. Enjoy and as always, thanks for watching and for your support.

recentItems.title: 2026 Lake County Fair (Painesville, OH)
recentItems.description:
3 fairs in 3 days was my goal, and despite not feeling well, that mission was accomplished with a trip to the incredibly awful Lake County Fair in Painesville, Ohio. Kissel Amusements provided the midway once again with their budget ride lineup including Rock-O-Plane, Musik Express, MindWinder swings, and the Painesville debuts of the Expo Wheel and Round Up Your Skittles. I added a walk down the food and games midway to help pad out the length since this would have been like a 90 second video otherwise. 

I filmed this with the Insta360 Go Ultra again. I managed to tone down the saturation a bit, but I’m still having trouble getting used to framing with the separate screen. But since this is a crappy fair, some crappy footage just helps lend to the overall vibe. Next week is the Medina County Fair for my first look at Bates Brothers in 2026. As always, thanks for watching and appreciate your support!

recentItems.title: 2026 Ohio State Fair (Columbus, OH)
recentItems.description:
So let’s talk about this commentary-free video of the 2026 Ohio State Fair, which was really, really good this year. As I’m not feeling the best, I ended up missing several rides, including Hard Rock, Storm and Black Pearl. Plus, Spin-A-Tron, Orbiter and Scorpion appeared to be down, and the new Dominator coaster did not run… so that’s at least 7 rides not included. Plus, I decided to not film the dedicated Kiddieland area. And to top it all off, today was Sensory Awareness morning, so there is no music on music rides, no Monkey Maze spiels, no Carousel music, no bands, and worst of all, no “exit to the left. Exit NOW!” On the FastTrax slide. 🫤. Aside from all that, there’s plenty of rides still here, most of which were supplied by Talley Amusements. There’s Iron Dragon (with a vertical POV), Big Kahuna, the new Freedom Wheel, Haunted House (with POV), Wave Swinger, Twister, Downdraft, Mega Drop (again with vertical POV… I really need to learn how to use the Insta360 Go Ultra), Helix 360, the new and completely stunning Ohio Carousel, and Skyliner (with a horizontal POV!). Enjoy and as always, thanks for watching.

recentItems.title: 2026 Summit County Fair (Tallmadge, OH)
recentItems.description:
After a longer break than expected, fair season is back here on the channel with a brief, commentary-free visit to the Summit County Fair in Tallmadge, Ohio just outside of Akron. Lisko Family Amusements supplied the midway, with a small handful of rides including their “new” Dartron/Battech Hang Glider (I’m sure one of the Lisko’s will yell at me again for not knowing the exact manufacturer. I would have went to their website for verification, but it no longer exists 🙄), Luna Park “Nostalgia Wheel”, Sellner Tilt-A-Whirl, their rare Chance SkyDiver, the Avengers Miami ride (again, can’t wait to be yelled at for not knowing the manufacturer), and the hilarious Hellstorm Super Sizzler from Wisdom, which was using the attract jingle from the “Argo Express” 🤷🏻‍♂️. Their Technical Park Street Fighter Revolution called Carnage was present, but was down and didn’t look like it was going to run for a bit based on tarps being strewn on the platform. 

This video was filmed on my new Insta360 Go Ultra, and you can definitely tell I haven’t quite figured out all of its nuances. The colors just scream “oversaturated”, it appears that my shadow is floating like a ghost (maybe I’m dead?), and the video quality is not quite as good as the iPhone, so it will probably only get used for POV’s or when a crackhead Karen yells at me for filming.

Coming in the next few days will be the 2026 Ohio State Fair and probably the Lake County Fair, so hopefully that will make up for the lack of content these past few weeks. Remaining fairs for the season should be Medina County, Cuyahoga County, Lorain County, Canfield/Mahoning County, Delaware County, Wayne County and Tuscarawas County. Erie County Fair in Hamburg, NY is on the agenda, but is not fully confirmed. As always, thanks for your support and thanks for watching!

recentItems.title: Mass Ride Simulator (iOS) - Updates and New Rides
recentItems.description: Since my first video of Mass Ride Simulator for iOS did relatively well, and since I was a bit harsh on the app at that time, I decided to revisit the ride operation simulator after many updates have been made. The result is a MUCH better experience with some unusual new rides, although some of the quirks are still there. This video only includes new and updated rides, so if you want to see the rest of the rides the app has to offer, feel free to check out the original video. Updates were made to the Crazy Dance, Ballerina and most importantly, the Musik Express now looks like a proper version of the ride. They even threw in a Caterpillar-style canopy on it! New rides added since the original video include a Tagada, a Mondial Heart Breaker, a Matterhorn, a Technical Park Heavy Rotation, and two unique variations of the Kamikaze. While still not perfect, it’s a much more well-balanced experience these days, so if you’re looking for a fun way to kill some time, give the app a try. (Disclaimer: This is NOT a paid ad for the app by any means. I made this simply for fun.)

recentItems.title: 2026 Lake Erie Crushers Carnival (Avon, OH)
recentItems.description:
Hey look- a bonus video! 🤪. I decided to check out Big O Amusements at the Lake Erie Crushers Carnival in Avon, OH, and allow me to retract anything bad I may have said or implied about Big O. With the additions of new rides like an ARM Vertigo, ARM RockStar, Majestic Scooter, and Dartron Cliff Hanger, Big O has built themselves a pretty impressive lineup of rides. 

Please note that this video was shot in one take and I did not do it the usual way of filming each ride individually. Heck, some of the rides you won’t even see in action as it was pretty slow, and also freaking hot outside. I’ll try to go back to the old way of filming at the next fair, which should be Trumbull County next month. Again, my sincerest thanks for watching.

recentItems.title: 2026 Summer In The City Festival (Middleburg Heights, OH)
recentItems.description: After a long break, carnival and fair season is back in Northeast Ohio with the 3-day Summer In The City Festival in my hometown of Middleburg Heights, Ohio. McGinnis Amusements provided the rides again, with the same lineup as last year being set up in the Community Center parking lot. For the low (!) price of $30, you can ride a Hurricane, Eli Wheel, Fun Slide, Loop-O-Plane, Scrambler and Berry-Go-Round, plus a handful of kids rides and the rare Wisdom Arabian Nights as many times as you want. Commentary is included, however I did add some commentary-free footage of Loop-O-Plane and Hurricane after the Ray P’s Videos title card. As always, enjoy and thanks for watching.

recentItems.title: Pirate’s Cove walk thru and Paratrooper footage (Waldameer; Erie, PA)
recentItems.description: I don’t usually make the trek through Waldameer’s other Bill Tracy dark attraction Pirate’s Cove, but since there was no line, I mustered up the courage and ventured in. Like Whacky Shack, the park does an amazing job keeping this in great shape and they even added a new scene this year in place of the old bar maze that even pays tribute to the late, great Mr. Tracy. Afterwards, I also added a quick look at the new home of Waldameer’s returning Paratrooper. Completely refurbished and looking brand new, it’s nice to see the park retaining some of the old classics. As always, thanks for watching. Hopefully with fair season kicking into gear next week, I’ll have some more content to share.

recentItems.title: Whacky Shack - Waldameer; Erie, PA (Bill Tracy dark ride- POV 2026)
recentItems.description: It wouldn’t be amusement park season here without an annual ride through Waldameer’s classic Whacky Shack dark ride. Not much has changed this year, but I believe they added LED lights on the bottom of each ride vehicle (you can see it in the mirrored strobe room). Aside from Joe Ghoul not popping up from behind his gravestone, all props and gags were working and looked great.
